empirical_constants.name: Inducer preferred incidence-to-blade-angle ratio
empirical_constants.context: SP-8052 sec.3.1.9 mean preference within 0.35 (thin blades) to 0.50 (thick blades). Wider flow ranges may require a larger ratio. This is not a universal bound.

empirical_constants.name: Inducer preferred odd blade number
empirical_constants.context: SP-8052 sec.3.1.14 recommends two to five blades, with three or four preferred. An odd count prevents alternate cavitation when other considerations permit.
empirical_constants.quote: three is therefore a preferred choice if other, more critical considerations permit.

empirical_constants.name: Low-head inducer proper solidity
empirical_constants.context: SP-8052 sec.3.1.15: 2.5 for the low-head inducer proper; high-head inlet flat-plate solidity is 2.0 to 2.5, with the outlet treated separately.
empirical_constants.quote: the solidity a should be 2.5 for the inducer proper.

supports_model.mismatch_notes: Source selections and constant-lead geometry are supported. Repository advisory thresholds, sizing rules, and missing cavity/head-rise validation prevent whole-model equivalence.

equation_links.reason: Pitch matches the constant-lead identity; complete inducer/NPSH screening includes repository heuristics and unqualified suction performance.

comparison.source: Eq. (1a), PDF p.19 (printed 7): S_s = n sqrt(Q) / NPSH^0.75.
comparison.implementation: omega sqrt(Q) / (g NPSH_head)^0.75, using coherent SI quantities.
comparison.verdict: UNIT_CONVENTION_VARIANT: the published dimensional suction speed and the code nondimensional value require a unit conversion before numerical chart comparisons.

comparison.source: Eq. (31), PDF p.34, and sec.3.1.10, PDF p.69.
comparison.implementation: pitch = 2 pi r_tip tan(beta_tip); hub angle follows the same constant lead.
comparison.verdict: EQUIVALENT geometric identity. The source discusses uniform flow, zero prewhirl and small blade angles when describing optimal radial angle variation.

comparison.source: Sec.3.1.9, PDF p.69: incidence ratio 0.35 to 0.50, mean 0.425; a wider flow range may require a larger ratio.
comparison.verdict: SUPPORTED default selection; the wider-flow-range caveat and source design range are not enforced here.

comparison.implementation: Defaults of three blades and solidity 2.5.
comparison.verdict: SUPPORTED selections for the described low-head inducer. Other accepted inputs need separate review.

comparison.source: Sec.3.2.1, PDF p.71: monotone head increase without backflow, radial equilibrium and cavity analysis.
comparison.implementation: Kinematic geometry and a pressure-margin recommendation, without a local cavity or head-rise solution.
comparison.verdict: NOT_IMPLEMENTED by this function; source design requirements do not establish code suction performance.

model_review.physics_finding: No engineering edits. Advisory suction-speed threshold, eye diameter floor and hub choices remain repository assumptions. Cavitation/head-rise and operating-range evidence is required for qualification.
